_comment: Channel configuration. source_url = single IPTV stream URL; source_urls = ordered list of primary + backup URLs tried on failover. Set enabled=false to skip. PROVIDER NOTE (tvon247.com): Xtream panel that (a) FILTERS user-agents — only an app/browser UA passes, the IPTV Smarters UA in run_channel.sh works; (b) serves live via a no-extension URL that 302-redirects to a tokenized segment host; ffmpeg follows it automatically. Account 9WZELTN, 5 max connections.

channels._comment_source: tvon247 id 1027109 = DAZN MUNDIAL HD (the live World Cup / Mundial feed; H264 1080p25, MP2 stereo). No channel is literally named 'FIFA World Cup 2026' on this provider — DAZN Mundial is the live match carrier for the MX/LatAm package.
channels._comment_audio: Real source audio restored: this provider delivers clean, tightly-synced stereo (A/V gap ~0.3s, not the old runaway clocks). Set force_silent_audio=true only if a specific feed's audio desyncs.
channels._comment_video: REVERTED to encode 2026-06-24: copy mode broke with mediaError/bufferAppendError when this flaky source dropped to the re-encoded STANDBY clip — the codec params differ from the copied live stream, so hls.js could not append across the live<->standby transition. The 540p re-encode normalizes live+standby to identical params (robust). Copy needs the standby-codec-mismatch fixed before re-enabling.

channels._comment_source: tvon247 id 1349033 = (ES) VIX - CANAL 5, H264 720p30 + AAC stereo. Switched from 1028333 (MX CANAL 5 HD) on 2026-06-24: that feed stalled-then-raced and flipped HEVC<->H264 (delivered 0s in a 25s raw test). VIX delivers steadily AND is consistent H264 (cheaper decode than the HEVC feed). Other Canal 5 ids on this provider were down at switch time: 30634 LATINO, 214633 HOND (0s); 273253 UY raced (2x).
channels._comment_audio: REAL AUDIO via audio_sync=preserve (2026-06-24). VIX Canal 5's A/V is aligned AT THE SOURCE (gap ~0.06s) but it OVER-DELIVERS audio; the default asetpts=N/SR/TB regen rebuilt PTS from the inflated sample count and raced the audio ~26h ahead of video (browser wouldn't start). 'preserve' keeps the source's aligned PTS (asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS) instead. If audio ever desyncs again, set force_silent_audio=true to fall back to silent.
channels._comment_video: REVERTED to encode 2026-06-24 (same reason as channel1): copy mode bufferAppendError at the live<->standby codec boundary on this flaky source. Re-enable copy only after the standby-codec-mismatch is fixed (e.g. skip standby for copy channels, or insert a clean discontinuity + codec re-init).

channels._comment_source: tvon247 id 1028359 = MX - ESPN HD (H264 720p60, AAC stereo).
channels._comment_audio: Real source audio restored (A/V gap ~0.01s, clean).
channels._comment_video: video_mode: COPY pending bitrate validation. 2026-06-24: its 720p60 source was fast-failing (stuck in STANDBY), so the live copy bitrate could not be measured against the ~6.4 Mbps client link. Left on 'encode' (proven 540p30) for safety. Flip to 'copy' to restore native 720p60 once the source is stable enough to confirm copy bitrate <~4.5 Mbps and segments <~10s.
